title: $\mathcal Z$-Stability and Regularity of Nuclear $C^*$-Algebras
exact_target: Does $\mathcal Z$-stability imply finite nuclear dimension for all unital simple separable nuclear $C^*$-algebras? More broadly, does the equivalence between $\mathcal Z$-stability and strict comparison hold without the additional hypotheses currently known?
